import dimod
import math

def calculate_edges(coordinates_m, communication_radius_m):

G.add_weighted_edges_from(edges, 1)

penalty = penalty

final_shots = final_shots
maxiter = maxiter
seed = seed

creg = ClassicalRegister(len(graph_vertices), 'c')

# Create QAOA Energy Estimator and Fitness
energy_estimator = QAOAEnergyEstimator(qc, qaoa)
fitness = QAOAFitness(qc, qaoa, G)

dwave_sampler = DWaveSampler(solver_options={"qpu": "adv_qpu"})

for i, (u, v) in enumerate(edges):

# Define the Hamiltonian for the QAOA objective function
h = qc.hamiltonian(energy_estimator)
x = qc.initial_state(qreg)

# Define the problem instance for the D-Wave Ocean Sampler
dwave_problem = dimod.QuadraticModel(energy_estimator.to_bing_quadratic_form())

# Run the QAOA algorithm on the D-Wave Ocean QPU
qc = transpile(qc, dwave_sampler)
results = []
for _ in range(maxiter):
    dwave_problem.set_objective(qc.hamiltonian(energy_estimator))
    dwave_sampleset = dwave_sampler.sample_using_qpu(dwave_problem, num_reads=final_shots, num_warmup_reads=opt_shots, seed_rng=seed)
    energies = [dwave_sample['energy'] for dwave_sample in dwave_sampleset]
    results.append((energies, dwave_sampleset))

# Extract the best solution and its energy
best_energy = min(energies for energies, _ in results)
best_sample = next((dwave_sample for energies, dwave_sample in results if min(energies) == best_energy))
best_solution = best_sample['sample']

# Calculate the number of active qubits (in the independent set)
active_qubits = [int(bit) for bit in best_solution]
independent_set_size = sum(active_qubits)

# Calculate the validity rate
valid_solution = all(bit == active_qubits[i] for i, bit in enumerate(best_sample['sample']) if active_qubits[i] == 1)
validity_rate = 1 if valid_solution else 0

# Calculate the embedding overhead
embedding_overhead = len(G.edges()) / (independent_set_size * (independent_set_size - 1))

# Calculate the resource cost

# Print the results
print("independent_set_ratio:", independent_set_size / len(graph_vertices))
print("validity_rate:", validity_rate)
print("embedding_overhead:", embedding_overhead)
print("resource_cost:", resource_cost)
